quote: The Antigua Public Utilities Authority (APUA) and Seven Seas Water Group (SSWG) … have jointly announced the opening of the Ffryes Beach seawater reverse osmosis (SWRO) desalination plant. The plant has a capacity of 1 million imperial gallons per day (IMGD) … This is the first of two SWRO plants that APUA and SSWG announced as part of their WaaS® agreement in March 2024. … Headquartered in Tampa, with operations across the U.S., Caribbean, and Latin America
note: Opened Seven Seas English release 25 Mar 2025 (Ffryes Beach 1 IMGD SWRO COD).
